dependency_order: An `incident` supplies necessary system context and vocabulary before dependent timeline or causal analysis (§4.4).

slots.name: Summary
slots.description: What happened, current state, and the bounded causal claim, if any.

slots.name: Impact
slots.description: Affected users or systems, duration, severity measures, and known exclusions.

slots.name: Timeline
slots.description: Timestamped events with time zone and source when the source matters.

slots.name: Observations
slots.description: Logs, measurements, changes, and reproduced facts, without causal interpretation.

slots.name: Causal analysis
slots.description: Supported causal chain, contributing conditions, confidence, and contrary evidence. State "undetermined" when the evidence does not identify a cause.

slots.name: Remediation
slots.description: Actions taken to restore or contain the incident and evidence that service or process recovered.

slots.name: Follow-up
slots.description: Preventive and detective work, owners or roles, due states, and verification of completion.
